name: Trello
description: Trello cards. Each Trello board is a collection, and each list on the board is a status. Restrict the connection to some workspaces in the settings.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Open trello.com/power-ups/admin. Make a Power-Up for your workspace. Open the API key page of the Power-Up. Copy the API key.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: On the API key page, click the Token link. Allow access. Copy the token. The token gives read and write access to your boards.
